name: Mikazuki Tooko
source: The protagonist's boss and head of the Cresent Partnership pharma syndicate. Capitalizing on the fact that the protagonist’s battles cause zero casualties and no public harm, she aims to rebrand the conflicts into a local superhero show. Her goal is to turn these fights into a town revitalization event that draws in tourists.
